## Session: Add rate limiting

> USER: Add rate limiting to the API endpoints

> ASSISTANT: I've added a sliding window rate limiter using Redis. Configuration:
- Default: 100 requests per minute per API key
- Configurable per-endpoint via `rate_limits.yaml`
- Returns 429 with `Retry-After` header when exceeded

The implementation uses composition: `RateLimiter` wraps any handler without inheritance.
